content: Direct analog: jeremylongshore/cad-ai-agent — AEC drawing intelligence platform. Upload DXF/PDF/DWG, describe intent in plain English, get: structured edits (move/rotate/copy/scale/mirror/delete, add line/polyline/circle/arc/text/block — 13 entity types, 13 ops), compliance checks (ADA/IBC/custom rules), health report (layer org + entity stats), quantity takeoff (counts/lengths/areas), plain-English summary, auto-generated RFIs from ambiguities, closed-loop zone/area detection, and revision diff/compare-apply. Safety: LLM planner returns structured operations only, never touches raw DXF; protected layers (TITLE/TITLEBLOCK/SEAL/REVISION) locked; save-as workflow preserves original. Stack: Python/FastAPI/ezdxf backend, React+Vite frontend, pluggable LLM (mock/Gemini/Claude). Agent Mode does iterative multi-turn tool-use (max 10 turns) for complex requests.
